title: TyphoonWorld: A Residual Token World Model for Probabilistic Forecasting of Typhoon Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2611.18740v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A satellite forecast of a typhoon should give a low-error picture of the next two days, together with an ensemble whose members are coherent fields and whose spread responds to the storm at hand. A small direct regression network already gives the lowest squared error on held-out storms, so a generative model has to earn its cost through the part of the future that the regression smooths away. We present TyphoonWorld, a discrete-token world model that generates only that part. Conditioned on tokens of the regression forecast, the latest frames and the best-track state at forecast time, it samples residual fields lead by lead, and members add these residuals to the regression center. We compare it under one protocol with per-pixel Gaussian networks, a diffusion model of the same residuals, residuals from other storms and an unconditional token world model, on 276 forecast windows from 46 held-out storms of Digital Typhoon. TyphoonWorld

translated_title: TyphoonWorld：用于台风图像概率预报的残差标记世界模型
translated_abstract: 台风的卫星预报应当给出未来两天低误差的图像，同时提供一个集合预报，其成员是连贯的场，且集合离散度能够针对眼前这场风暴作出响应。一个小的直接回归网络在留出的风暴上已经能取得最低的平方误差，因此生成模型必须通过刻画回归所平滑掉的那部分未来内容来证明其成本的合理性。我们提出了 TyphoonWorld，一个仅生成该部分内容的离散标记（token）世界模型。该模型以回归预报的标记、最新的若干帧以及预报时刻的最佳路径状态为条件，逐时效（lead by lead）地采样残差场，各集合成员再将这些残差加到回归中心之上。我们在统一的评测协议下，将其与逐像素高斯网络、对相同残差建模的扩散模型、来自其他风暴的残差以及无条件的标记世界模型进行比较，实验数据来自 Digital Typhoon 数据集中 46 个留出风暴的 276 个预报窗口。
tldr: TyphoonWorld 提出了一种离散标记残差世界模型，仅生成回归预报所平滑掉的残差场，从而为台风卫星图像提供成员连贯且离散度能随具体风暴变化的概率集合预报。
en_tdlr: TyphoonWorld is a discrete-token residual world model that generates only the residual fields smoothed away by a regression forecast, enabling probabilistic ensemble forecasting of typhoon satellite imagery with coherent members and spread that adapts to the storm at hand.
